user.title: School Menu Configuration
user.description: Configure the PDF source and menu structure for your school.

data.settimane_ciclo: Number of weeks in the cycle
data.portate_per_giorno: Courses per day (only used in 'fixed' mode)

data_description.data_inizio_anno: First day of school. The menu cycle starts from this date.
data_description.data_fine_est_1: The spring/summer menu is used up to (but not including) this date. From this date the winter menu begins.
data_description.data_inizio_est_2: From this date the spring/summer menu resumes until the end of the school year.
data_description.data_fine_anno: From this date onwards the sensor will show 'Eating at home!' even on weekdays.
data_description.settimana_inizio_est_1: Week number (1 to cycle length) from which the first spring/summer period starts.
data_description.settimana_inizio_inv: Week number (1 to cycle length) from which the winter period starts. Enter 0 to continue automatically from where the previous period left off.
data_description.settimana_inizio_est_2: Week number (1 to cycle length) from which the second spring/summer period starts. Enter 0 to continue automatically from where the winter period left off.
data_description.modalita_blocco: How the integration detects where one day ends and the next begins in the PDF table. Use 'auto' if unsure.
data_description.portate_nomi: Enter the names of the courses in the order they appear in the PDF. Example: first course, second course, side dish, fruit, bread
data_description.portate_per_giorno: Only used when 'fixed' mode is selected. Must match the number of course names entered above.
